slices.focus: Ayaka uses leave for a proper spring checkup and shifts from reactive symptom management to proactive load management before storm season intensifies.
slices.summary: Instead of waiting for another bad stretch, Ayaka uses leave for a spring checkup. The results are normal, but the experience shifts her approach from symptom control (ginger candy, anti-nausea meds) to load management: earlier meals before overnight monitoring, protected sleep windows, and fewer unnecessary island crossings. She creates a three-line notes card (meal time, sleep cutoff, crossing check) and distinguishes purposeful crossings from reflexive ones. Her baseline dread going into summer is noticeably lower than the previous year.
